scope: Single-entry quality review of Mubert. Verified the current creator and developer music platform, Render generation/editing, Cast podcast editing, Fuse short-video workflow, Copyright Checker, API generation/streaming, current Render plan limits/prices and the precise non-commercial/commercial licensing boundaries; refined the existing listing without changing lifecycle status.

accepted.name: Mubert
accepted.description: AI music platform for prompt/chat- and image-to-music soundtrack generation, with track remixing and editing, stem control, a transcript-based podcast editor, short-video music/voice/SFX/subtitle tools, and a music-generation and streaming API for apps and games.
accepted.userValue: For video creators, podcasters, streamers and developers who need soundtracks or licensed music workflows. Render's free Ambassador plan offers 25 tracks/month and 5 downloads with attribution and non-commercial restrictions; Creator is $14/month or $11.69/month billed annually (non-commercial), Pro is $39/month or $32.49/month annually (commercial use, monetized content and full Track Editor), and Business is $199/month or $149.29/month annually (client/agency/app use and sublicensing). API plans are separate. Generated tracks cannot be redistributed as standalone music, uploaded to Spotify or registered in Content ID; check the license for your specific channel or project before use.

notes: Mubert is an active multi-product AI music platform. The current official homepage lists Mubert Render for creators, Chat to Music, Mubert Cast for transcript-based podcast editing and audio cleanup, Mubert Fuse for adding music/voice/SFX/subtitles to short videos, Copyright Checker, and Mubert API for apps and brands.

Render can generate tracks from text prompts, chat, images, genre, mood and BPM, and supports Quick Remix, stem regeneration/removal and a Full Track Editor. The official What's New page lists 2026 launches including Fuse (May 26), Quick Remix (July 28), Track Editor (August 26) and Cast (September 10).

Render pricing: Ambassador Free includes 25 tracks/month, 5 downloads/month, fixed duration, MP3, a watermark and required attribution; it is non-commercial. Creator costs $14/month or $11.69/month billed annually, includes 500 tracks/month, up to 25-minute tracks, lossless downloads and unlimited downloads, but remains non-commercial. Pro costs $39/month or $32.49/month billed annually, adds commercial usage, monetized content, digital ads and the Full Track Editor. Business costs $199/month or $149.29/month billed annually and adds client/freelance/agency work, apps/games/services and sublicensing.

The API is a separate product with separate plans, generation/streaming quotas, webhooks, curated-library access and licensing terms. Render subscriptions should not be treated as API subscriptions or as granting sublicensing rights.

Mubert's current Render pricing and license comparison explicitly prohibit selling or distributing tracks as standalone music, publishing them to Spotify/other music streaming services, or registering them in Content ID systems. Creator is non-commercial; Pro covers commercial/monetized projects; Business is required for client/agency/app use and sublicensing. Users must match the plan to the actual use case.

The free Ambassador plan requires attribution and includes only five downloads per month. The free label does not imply commercial rights. License certificates are provided for generated tracks, and false-positive copyright claims may still occur.
